description: Source code for the LSM6DSV16X sensor driver, specifically handling interrupt triggers and configurations for the 6-axis IMU sensor.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_enable_xl_int
methods.description: Enables or disables the accelerometer interrupt pin.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_enable_g_int
methods.description: Enables or disables the gyroscope interrupt pin.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_trigger_set
methods.description: Links external trigger to data ready event for accelerometer or gyroscope.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the data ready interrupt, reads data, and calls registered handlers.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes interrupt handling, configures GPIOs and data ready mode.
